name: product-manager-assistant
description: Comprehensive Product Manager plugin with 8 expert agents, 12 deep-skill modules, and 4 interactive commands. Master every aspect of product management from strategy and discovery through launch, analytics, and operations. SASMP v1.3.0 compliant.
author: Product Manager Agent System

agents.name: Strategy & Vision Agent
agents.description: Master market analysis, competitive positioning, product vision, and go-to-market strategy. Define winning positions and long-term success.

agents.name: Discovery & Research Agent
agents.description: Expert in user research, customer interviews, persona development, and journey mapping. Understand customer problems deeply.

agents.name: Requirements & Definition Agent
agents.description: Transform insights into clear requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria. Define specifications that engineering can execute.

agents.name: Roadmap & Prioritization Agent
agents.description: Master prioritization frameworks (RICE, MoSCoW, Kano), roadmap planning, and resource allocation. Create focused, executable roadmaps.

agents.name: Launch & GTM Agent
agents.description: Plan and execute successful product launches. Master go-to-market strategy, sales enablement, and launch coordination.

agents.name: Analytics & Metrics Agent
agents.description: Define KPIs, build dashboards, run A/B tests, and make data-driven decisions. Measure what matters and optimize continuously.

agents.name: Leadership & Stakeholder Agent
agents.description: Master stakeholder management, executive communication, cross-functional alignment, and product advocacy. Lead effectively.

agents.name: Product Operations Agent
agents.description: Streamline product operations, agile practices, tooling, and team processes. Optimize delivery and operational excellence.
